retrieval_method.note: The sandbox shell egress allowlist cannot open www.nfl.com (TLS reset), so the official page is read with the agent page-fetch tool and the relevant blocks are transcribed verbatim to disk. A SHA-256 proves these bytes were not altered after capture; it does not prove the capture is a complete transcription of the page.

cross_check: Two independent official pages (the week-10 scores page and the game page) both print WAS 24 - NYG 21, Final. The game page quarter cells sum to the printed totals.
